title: Record
description: One decision, from what the model was given to what happened. Written to an append-only JSONL file: every state transition appends a full snapshot of the record; consumers take the last line per record_id. This is the training set the product did not start with.

actor.description: Who saw the card. Hashed ids only; never raw identifiers.

input.description: The full input snapshot. Not a reference: references go stale and cannot be backfilled. This is the field that makes the record trainable later.

template_version.description: Version of the prompt template that produced `messages`.

retrieval_ids.description: Ids of retrieved items included in `messages`, so evidence.ref can be checked.

context_hash.description: Hash of `messages`; lets you group records that saw the same situation.

hypothesis.description: The bet this deployment is testing. Copied from hypothesis.json so each record knows what it is measuring.

name.description: As reported by the endpoint, e.g. the Ollama tag or vLLM served-model name.

version.description: Digest or build id where the runtime exposes one.

highlight_shown.description: False for the holdout share of cards, where the recommended option is rendered without its highlight. Needed to separate preference from the nudge.

candidates.description: Present only in candidates mode: the other sampled cards for the same input. Enables card-vs-card preference pairs.

shown_index.description: Which candidate was rendered, when candidates mode is on.

repair.description: Present when the model's first reply failed validation and it was asked once to fix it. `card` is the result of that second turn, whether it succeeded (a decision card) or not (prose). `input.messages` stays the original prompt.

problems.description: What was wrong with the first reply, as sent back to the model.

answered.description: The person's answer to `ask`, if the card had one and they answered.

recommended_id.description: The model's recommendation, whether or not it was highlighted (see shown.highlight_shown).

agreed.description: option_id === recommended_id. Null when the model had no recommendation.

override_reason.description: Collected through the Ask primitive when agreed is false. An override without a reason is one bit of information.

time_to_choose_ms.description: From shown.at to the tap. Fast agreement on a highlighted option is a weak signal.

evidence_expanded.description: Whether the person opened the evidence before choosing, where the skin collapses it.

outcome.description: What happened. Written first at outcome_pending with only `due_at`; `source` and `at` are added when the record closes or expires. `source` says how you know. `none` with status expired is a legitimate, and common, end state.

option_id.description: The check_in option chosen (self) or mapped from the system of record (system). `cant_tell` is always available.

metric.description: Optional system-of-record measurement tied to the hypothesis.
